issue_context.title: Entity XXX_nergy_cost (<class 'homeassistant.components.energy.sensor.EnergyCostSensor'>) with state_class measurement has set last_reset
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Upgraded to 2021.9.5.

Got these warnings on logs, the sensors are self-created from energy grid:

```
2021-09-09 07:14:46 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Entity sensor.shellyem_c45bbe5fed52_channel_1_energy_cost (<class 'homeassistant.components.energy.sensor.EnergyCostSensor'>) with state_class measurement has set last_reset. Setting last_reset is deprecated and will be unsupported from Home Assistant Core 2021.11. Please update your configuration if state_class is manually configured, otherwise create a bug report at https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22integration%3A+energy%22


2021-09-09 07:14:47 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Entity sensor.gas_reading_cost (<class 'homeassistant.components.energy.sensor.EnergyCostSensor'>) with state_class measurement has set last_reset. Setting last_reset is deprecated and will be unsupported from Home Assistant Core 2021.11. Please update your configuration if state_class is manually configured, otherwise create a bug report at https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22integration%3A+energy%22
```

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.9.5

Home Assistant Container

Or is SUM fine, because we want the total "cost", which is net anyway?
Yeah, for cost sensors we just need the total sum.
